timeline.summary: OnEMI board approved investing ₹637.50 Cr of IPO proceeds into its NBFC subsidiary Si Creva via a rights issue.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹619.35 Cr, net profit ₹82.18 Cr.
OnEMI Technology released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, guiding for 10-15% AUM growth in FY27.
RAJKUMAR PATANGIA uploaded the Q4FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 29, 2026, for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026.

On 14 October 2026, OnEMI Technology Solutions' shareholders approved the preferential issue of equity shares on a private placement basis at the first EGM of FY27, with 97.93% of valid votes in favour.
On October 16, 2026, OnEMI Technology Solutions clarified valuation report pricing for its proposed preferential issue following stock exchange queries.
NSE and BSE granted in-principle approval for preferential issue of up to 2.65 Cr equity shares at ₹314.11 each, aggregating ₹832.20 Cr.
OnEMI Technology Solutions allotted 2,64,93,882 equity shares via preferential issue, raising ₹832.20 Cr.
